name: devops-assistant
description: GitOps-first Kubernetes operations for Claude: Argo CD/Workflows, Helm, Kustomize, RCA, validation and security gates, with a hard lock on destructive actions and zero credential exposure.

steveVoice.title: Steve's voice
steveVoice.description: The macOS voice Steve speaks with when ♪ voice is on in the k8s pane. auto picks the most natural English voice installed: one marked (Premium), then (Enhanced), else Rocko. Download more natural voices in System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System voice → Manage Voices. A voice that is not installed falls back to the system default.

steveSwearing.title: Steve swears
steveSwearing.description: Steve is a grumpy DevOps engineer either way. On, he uses mild bad words about the code and the situation (crap, damn, hell). Off, he stays grumpy but clean.
